name: World Rugby Museum and stadium tour, Twickenham
summary: Explore rugby history in the World Rugby Museum and go behind the scenes on a guided tour of the national stadium. Tour routes can include the changing room, players' tunnel and pitchside areas, subject to stadium operations.
reasonToVisit: Rugby history and a behind-the-scenes tour of the national stadium
planningDetail: Tours are timed and can change around matches or events
